nonBlockingObservations.observation: DEC00 asks broadly to recheck offer identity/price/modifiers when the price alone is unknown; the per-card notice does identify the missing price. More precise field-level questions remain a UX improvement.

The main full-inventory card shows a hypothetical Abstract contribution+18 and the explicit no-space warning; its legal replacement subconsultation correctly shows+15. Marking unavailable projections more compactly would reduce confusion. The illegal main action is not recommended.
